name: cjk-text-layout
description: Build and audit Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text layout against W3C requirements.

interface.shortDescription: Build and audit CJK typography against W3C requirements.
interface.longDescription: CJK Text Layout helps agents implement and audit Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text layout according to W3C JLReq, CLReq, and KLReq, covering writing modes, line breaking, punctuation placement, ruby and annotations, vertical text, mixed-script spacing, justification, and ebook or PDF page layout.
defaultPrompt: Use $cjk-layout to implement CJK text layout against W3C requirements.
Use $cjk-layout-audit to audit this CJK webpage for layout issues.
Review CJK line breaking, punctuation, ruby, spacing, and vertical text.
